help:
usage: clef-use [-h]
                {run,status,abort,observe,continue,doctor,models,mcp,install-mcp,update,version,self-test,benchmark}
                ...

Local GUI automation through a shared CLI/MCP runtime.

positional arguments:
  {run,status,abort,observe,continue,doctor,models,mcp,install-mcp,update,version,self-test,benchmark}
    run                 execute a high-level GUI goal
    status              show session progress and terminal result
    abort               cancel the active GUI task
    observe             inspect the session screen and controls
    continue            resume a session with new guidance
    doctor              check model readiness and desktop permissions
    models              prepare inference dependencies and download or inspect
                        models
    mcp                 start the MCP server for an AI agent
    install-mcp         register clef-use with Codex, Hermes or OMP
    update              update the runtime while retaining model cache
    version             show the installed runtime version
    self-test           offline deterministic runtime smoke check
    benchmark           measure runtime behavior; --tasks performs real GUI
                        input

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

First use (the installer does not download models):
  clef-use models prepare   # install inference dependencies and download models
  clef-use doctor           # check models and desktop permissions
  clef-use run "your GUI goal"

Model preparation requires Python 3.11/3.12, Git and sufficient disk space.
See: https://github.com/snowman0919/clef-use/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md
models_help:
usage: clef-use models [-h] [--json] [--python PYTHON] [--rocm-arch ROCM_ARCH]
                       [--profile {auto,default,macos-mps,macos-cpu,linux-cuda,linux-rocm,linux-xpu,linux-cpu,windows-cuda,windows-rocm,windows-xpu,windows-cpu}]
                       [--quantization {none,4bit}]
                       [{list,download,prepare,profiles}]

Models are not downloaded by the installer. Run 'clef-use models prepare'
before your first GUI task; it installs inference dependencies, downloads
missing models and saves configuration after initialization succeeds.

positional arguments:
  {list,download,prepare,profiles}
                        list: cached models; download: weights only; prepare:
                        full setup; profiles: OS/backend choices

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --json                suppress setup progress; emit JSON result
  --python PYTHON
  --rocm-arch ROCM_ARCH
                        Windows ROCm ISA, e.g. gfx1150; autodetected when
                        available
  --profile {auto,default,macos-mps,macos-cpu,linux-cuda,linux-rocm,linux-xpu,linux-cpu,windows-cuda,windows-rocm,windows-xpu,windows-cpu}
  --quantization {none,4bit}
                        none: original weights; 4bit: bitsandbytes NF4 during
                        loading
